changes: SystemEvent retains the twelve-entry event table and the earlier unchecked FrontWindow result in IfTopWants. The later nil-window check is absent. The table uses a PC-relative address.
DiskHandler retains only the MountVol call and returns its result in the event message. The disk-eject event extensions added in September 1986 and the manual-eject handling added in 1993 are absent.

SystemClick keeps the DCE pointer in D3, reads the window variant from the high byte of WindowDef, and locks the loaded definition procedure by setting master-pointer bit seven. It clears the bit after the call. The later DCE handle, GetWVariant, HLock, and HUnlock paths are omitted.

SystemTask retains its driver timing loop and reentrancy lock. The later notification and balloon-help calls are absent. SystemMenu saves its registers before fetching the menu result and omits later help, keyboard, and input-method dispatch.

SystemEdit, OpenDeskAcc, CloseDeskAcc, driver-table lookup, driver messages, and window click handling retain their original bodies. The immediate Control trap is expressed as DC.W _Control+Immed, using the released trap word and flag equate. It emits $A204.

Five explicit short branches restore the original encodings. The original attribution, 1982–1985 histories, dispatch-table comments, and routine contracts remain. Two corrected comments identify the event range as 0–11 and the desk accessory return value as a reference number.
historical_limits: The source comparison and exact assembly verify emitted instructions and data. They do not execute desk accessory drivers or recover the lost source text.
